description: This file defines the InputParametersTab React component, which manages displaying, creating, and editing input parameters associated with a specific asset. It includes functions for fetching data, handling user interactions, displaying modals for form inputs, and updating state accordingly.

methods.name: toSelectOptions
methods.description: Filters an array to include only active items, considering optional isActive property.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of input parameters and updates the state, also managing the currently selected input parameter.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new input parameter and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with data from the selected row for editing and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating an input parameter, including validation, API calls, and UI updates.
